archetypes.name: dyn-zero-survivor
archetypes.rationale: Zero-survivor normalization crosses review core, Step 5, and prompt routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed zero-survivor path. Verify that only REVIEW_CORE_STATUS=panel-failed with THRESHOLD_REASON=no successful launched reviewer output maps to self-review-required, and that static coverage, dispatch, aggregator, and voter failures still fail normally. Check emitted env files and Step 5 envelopes for stable keys. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
